paite: Huai gam a mite'n Josiah tapa Jehoahaz api ua, Jerusalem ah apa sik in kumpipa in abawl uhi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Jehoahaz / (2 Kum 23.30-35)
english: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father’s place in Jerusalem.

paite: Jehoahaz in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih-le-thum ahi a, Jerusalem ah kha thum vai ahawm hi.
english: Joahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.

paite: Aigupta kumpipa'n Jerusalem a avaihawmna atawpsak a, agam uh dangkasik talent zakhat leh dangka-eng talent khat aliausak hi.
english: The king of Egypt removed him from office at Jerusalem, and fined the land one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

paite: Aigupta kumpipa'n a-unaupa Eliakim, Judah leh Jerusalem a kumpipa ding in abawl a, amin Jehoiakim chi in akhensak hi. Huchi in Neko in a-unaupa Jehoahaz Aigupta gam ah api hi.
english: The king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. Neco took Joahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.

paite: Jehoiakim in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-khat vai ahawm hi. TOUPA a Pathian mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Jehoiakim / (2 Kum 23.36-24.7)
english: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. He did that which was evil in Yahweh his God’s sight.

paite: Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar amah sual ding in ahong kuan a, Babulon a pi ding in kol abunsak hi.
english: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against him, and bound him in fetters to carry him to Babylon.

paite: Nebukadnezzar in TOUPA' inn a tui-um belsuan leng Babulon ah apua a, Babulon a atempul ah akoih hi.
english: Nebuchadnezzar also carried some of the vessels of Yahweh’s house to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.

paite: Jehoiakim tanchin dangte, athilkihhuai hihte leh a-omdante, ngai dih, Israel kumpipa leh Judah kumpite tanchinbu ah atuang hi. Huan asik in atapa Jehoiakin in vai ahawmta hi.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah; and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.

paite: Jehoiakin in vaihawm apat tung in kum giat ahi a, Jerusalem ah kha thum leh ni sawm vai ahawm a, TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Jehoiakin / (2 Kum 24.8-17)
english: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem. He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight.

paite: Kum abei in kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in mi asawl a, TOUPA in atui-um belsuan hoih pipite toh Babulon ah apisak a, a-unaupa Zedekiah, Judah gam leh Jerusalem a kumpipa ding in abawl hi.
english: At the return of the year, King Nebuchadnezzar sent and brought him to Babylon, with the valuable vessels of Yahweh’s house, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.

paite: Zedekiah in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih-le-khat ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-khat vai ahawm hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Zedekiah / (2 Kum 24.18-20; Jer 52.1-3)
english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

paite: TOUPA a Pathian mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; TOUPA kam a kipan a thugenpa zawlnei Jeremiah lak ah akiniamkhiak nuam kei hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh his God’s sight. He didn’t humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from Yahweh’s mouth.

paite: Pathian min a kichiamsakpa kumpipa Nebukadnezzar tung ah ahel lai a, genhaktak in a-om a, TOUPA, Israel' Pathian lam nga lou ding in alungsim akhauhsak hi.
heading: Jerusalem Puksiatna / (2 Kum 25.1-21; Jer 52.3b-11)
english: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God; but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart against turning to Yahweh, the God of Israel.

paite: Siampu heutu tengteng leh mipite'n leng Pathian thei lou mite mah bang in thilkihhuai pipite ahih ua, Jerusalem a hihsiangthou TOUPA' innte leng ahihbuah uhi.
english: Moreover all the chiefs of the priests and the people trespassed very greatly after all the abominations of the nations; and they polluted Yahweh’s house which he had made holy in Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N amite leh a-omna mun alainat ziak in apipute uh Pathian in akiang uah theihtawp a phatuamngai in mi asawl hi.
english: Yahweh, the God of their fathers, sent to them by his messengers, rising up early and sending, because he had compassion on his people and on his dwelling place;

paite: Himahleh Pathian misawlte amusit ua, athute angaineu ua, amite tung ah TOUPA hehna ahong thou a, hih lungdam nawnna mahmah om lou khop in azawlneite ahihgim uhi.
english: but they mocked the messengers of God, despised his words, and scoffed at his prophets, until Yahweh’s wrath arose against his people, until there was no remedy.

paite: Huaiziak in atung uah Kaldai kumpipa agamtangsak a, ama'n atangvalte uh amun siangthou uah namsau in athat a, nungak leh tangval, tek, teksia kuamah lainatna anei kei a; akhut ah ape vek hi.
english: Therefore he brought on them the king of the Chaldeans, who killed their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion on young man or virgin, old man or infirm. He gave them all into his hand.

paite: Pathian inn a tui-um belsuan tengteng, aneu leh alian, TOUPA' inn a sum koihkhawm tengteng, kumpipa sum koihkhawm leh amiliante sum koihkhawmte nangawn in Babulon ah apo vek hi.
english: All the vessels of God’s house, great and small, and the treasures of Yahweh’s house, and the treasures of the king and of his princes, all these he brought to Babylon.

paite: Pathian innte ahal a, Jerusalem kulhte achimsak a, huai lai a inn thupi tengteng ahal a, huai lai a tui-um belsuan hoih tengteng ahihse vek hi.
english: They burned God’s house, broke down the wall of Jerusalem, burned all its palaces with fire, and destroyed all of its valuable vessels.

paite: Namsau thah bang teng Babulon ah api a, Persiate ahong laltak un, sikha in amah leh atapate a-om uhi.
english: He carried those who had escaped from the sword away to Babylon, and they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia,

paite: Gam in nuamtak a a Sabbathte azattan a Jeremiah kam a TOUPA thugen atangtunna ding in, segawp a a-om sung teng, kum sawmsagih tangtunna ding in, a Sabbathte atang uhi.
english: to fulfill Yahweh’s word by Jeremiah’s mouth, until the land had enjoyed its Sabbaths. As long as it lay desolate, it kept Sabbath, to fulfill seventy years.

paite: Huchi in Persia kumpipa Kura vaihawm tung kum in Jeremiah kam a TOUPA thu atunkim theihna ding in agam tengteng a thankhiak vek ding leh agelh a gelh ding in leng TOUPA'N Persia kumpipa Kura lungtang atokthou hi.
heading: Kura In Judate Kik Nawn Ding Thu Apia / (Ezr 1.1-4)
english: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that Yahweh’s word by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

paite: Persia kumpipa Kura in hichi in achi: "Khovel gam tengteng TOUPA, van Pathian in ahon pia a; Judah gam a Jerusalem ah a-inn lamsak ding in thu ahon pia ahi. Na lak ua ama mite photphot kiang ah TOUPA a Pathian om henla, va hohtou uhen," chi in.
english: “Cyrus king of Persia says, ‘Yahweh, the God of heaven, has given all the kingdoms of the earth to me; and he has commanded me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Whoever there is among you of all his people, Yahweh his God be with him, and let him go up.’”
